# Coding Agent Task — Landing Page: Scandinavian Design **Your role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete landing page described below in a single attempt. Follow every rule in this document literally; where a rule and a personal habit conflict, the rule wins. --- ## Project Brief & Page Structure **Design language:** Scandinavian / Nordic — calm, monochrome, spacious, restrained, "quiet UI." The entire visual hierarchy is built from a black ink opacity ladder over a near-white canvas. No gradients, no decorative shadows, no all-caps text, left-aligned text everywhere, sentence case everywhere, one filled primary action per section. **Product concept:** Invent one coherent fictional product for the copy (e.g., a calm focus/writing/workspace tool with a Nordic-inspired name such as "Nordlys" or "Hviske"). Keep the name, tone, and terminology consistent across all sections. Write all user-facing copy in **English**, concise and calm. Lorem ipsum is forbidden — author realistic copy. **Sections, in DOM order:** * **Sticky header:** Text-only brand wordmark (weight 600), inline anchor nav ("Features", "How it works", "Pricing", "FAQ"), the theme toggle button, and one small filled primary button ("Get started"). On viewports < 640px, hide the nav links (the same anchors must exist in the footer). Background `var(--bg-primary)`, 1px bottom border `var(--border-default)`, `z-index: var(--z-dropdown)`. * **Hero:** Small sentence-case intro line in secondary ink, display headline (weight 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, max-width ~18–22ch, line-height 1.1), supporting paragraph (secondary ink, max-width 55–68ch), one filled primary CTA and one ghost/outline secondary CTA. Optionally include a single photograph from `https://picsum.photos` rendered monochrome via `filter: grayscale(1)` — otherwise keep the hero purely typographic. Left-aligned. * **Features — 3 cards:** Section heading + one-paragraph intro, then three cards in a wrapping flex row. Each card: one Google Material Symbol inside a quiet 44px tile (hover applies `var(--fill-hover)`), card title (weight 600, sentence case), description in secondary ink (max 3 lines of measure). * **How it works — 3 steps:** Steps numbered 01 / 02 / 03 in tertiary ink, each with a title and short description. Separate steps with a 1px top border `var(--border-default)`. Stack vertically on mobile. * **Testimonials — 3 quotes:** Each a `blockquote` with the quote in primary ink and a `figcaption`/cite line (name + role) in secondary ink. Thin 1px top border per quote; optional subtle "format_quote" Material Symbol in tertiary ink. * **Pricing — 3 tiers:** Each tier card: plan name, price (weight 600, large), billing period, feature list with small "check" Material Symbols, and a CTA. The middle tier is featured: `border-color: var(--primary)`, a small sentence-case "Most popular" badge (filled `var(--primary)` background, `var(--bg-primary)` text, `--radius-sm`), and the only filled primary button in the section; the other two tiers use ghost/outline buttons. * **FAQ — 5 accordion items:** Accessible accordion (see 2.4). First item open by default. * **Final CTA:** Display heading, supporting paragraph, and an email capture form (see 2.3). This section holds the single filled primary action for the chapter (the form submit button). * **Footer:** Top area: brand + one-line description plus 2–3 link columns ("Product", "Company", "Resources") containing the same section anchors plus secondary links. Bottom bar: copyright line and secondary links ("Privacy", "Terms", "Contact"). 1px top border; link hover applies `var(--fill-hover)` with `--radius-sm`. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * **No inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. * **Class/ID selectors only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are applied via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. No presentational attributes. * **Minimal HTML modifications:** HTML stays semantic and clean (`header`, `main`, `section`, `nav`, `footer`, `h1`–`h3` in logical order). Every section gets `aria-labelledby` pointing to its heading. Include a "Skip to content" link as the first focusable element. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** All visual tokens live in `:root` (and the dark overrides of 1.3) in `style.css`. Define exactly these names plus the values shown: ```css :root { /* Ink opacity ladder — light mode */ --primary: #000000; /* primary ink / primary action fill */ --secondary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64); /* secondary ink */ --bg-primary: #fefefe; /* canvas */ --bg-secondary: #f6f6f6; /* quiet fills: inputs, skeleton blocks */ --text-primary: #000000; --text-secondary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64); --text-tertiary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.44); /* numerals, micro-copy, large text only */ --text-success: #1e6b4f; --text-error: #b3261e; --border-default: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); --border-strong: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); --border-error: #b3261e; --border-success: #1e6b4f; --fill-hover: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); --fill-pressed: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09); --font-base: 'Inter', sans-serif; --radius-sm: 6px; --radius-md: 8px; --radius-lg: 12px; --shadow-sm: none; /* flat design: shadows stay none for this theme */ --shadow-md: none; --spacing-gap: 24px; --transition-fast: 150ms ease-out; --transition-normal: 240ms ease-out; --ease-standard: ease-out; --z-dropdown: 40; --z-modal: 60; --z-toast: 80; } ``` * **Exception note:** The source style sheet lists `#FFFFFF` as the canvas; per platform rules pure white is disallowed, so the near-white `#fefefe` substitutes as `--bg-primary`. All `rgba(0 0 0 / x%)` ladder values remain exactly as specified. * **Contrast pairing:** Light canvas pairs with black ink; dark canvas (1.3) pairs with light ink. The primary button is built as `background: var(--primary); color: var(--bg-primary);` so both themes pair correctly by construction. Reserve `--text-tertiary` for large text (≥18px) or non-essential micro-copy — never body paragraphs. * **Design tokens to enforce globally:** 8px spacing rhythm (all gaps/padding are multiples of 8); section vertical padding `clamp(4rem, 8vw, 9rem)`; radii only within 6–12px; body line-height 1.5–1.6; paragraph measure 55–68ch; font weights 400–600 only (weight 700–900 is forbidden); letter-spacing -0.01em on display sizes only. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support (Inverted Monochrome)** * **Token overrides:** Duplicate the full token set under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { … } }` and under a `.dark` class on ``. Dark values: `--primary: #fefefe; --bg-primary: #0a0a0a; --bg-secondary: #161616; --text-primary: #fefefe; --text-secondary: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.64); --text-tertiary: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.42); --border-default: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.14); --border-strong: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.30); --fill-hover: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.06); --fill-pressed: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.10); --text-success: #8fd3ae; --text-error: #f2b8b5; --border-error: #f2b8b5; --border-success: #8fd3ae; --secondary: rgba(254, 254, 254, 0.64)`. * **Theme switching:** No HTML restructuring when switching; only variable values change. Light mode is the default presentation. * **Persistence:** `script.js` reads `localStorage` ("theme" key) as the first statement on load (minimize flash), falls back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, toggles `.dark` on ``, and updates the toggle button's `aria-pressed` and `aria-label`. The toggle is a visible header button containing "dark_mode" and "light_mode" Material Symbols; CSS shows the correct icon per theme. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** * **Build all layout structures with Flexbox.** Do not use CSS Grid. * **Default alignment rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`. Explicitly justified exceptions only: (1) multi-card rows use `align-items: stretch` for equal heights; (2) card, step, and quote interiors use `align-items: flex-start` to preserve left-aligned text; (3) column stacks may use `align-items: flex-start`. Any other deviation must be commented in CSS with its justification. * **Mobile-friendly first:** Card/pricing/testimonial rows use `flex-wrap: wrap` with children `flex: 1 1 280px` so they collapse to a single column below ~768px with no horizontal scrolling. No fixed pixel widths on content; `img { max-width: 100%; }`. **1.5 Styling Approach & Naming Convention** * **Clean custom CSS path (explicit exception):** Do not load Tailwind or any framework; the source specification ships vanilla CSS, so per the clean-custom-CSS provision all styling lives in `style.css`. * **Single convention — BEM only:** `block__element--modifier` (e.g., `.hero`, `.hero__title`, `.card`, `.card__icon`, `.btn--primary`, `.faq__item`, `.faq__trigger--open`, `.input-group__error`, `.footer__link`). Never mix conventions, never invent utility classes, never use element selectors for styling (except base resets/typography on `body`, headings, and links). **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * **Text:** Inter via Google Fonts, weights 400, 500, 600 only — include these tags in ``: ```html ``` Bind to `--font-base` on `body`. Never use weights above 600. * **Icons:** Google Material Symbols Outlined only (`…`). Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji, and icon fonts other than Material Symbols are forbidden. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--small`)** * **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` min touch target 44×44px (`.btn--small` may keep 44px height), `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, `font-weight: 500`, sentence-case label, `transition: var(--transition-normal)`. Primary: filled `var(--primary)` background with `var(--bg-primary)` text. Ghost: transparent background, 1px `var(--border-strong)` border, `var(--text-primary)` text. * **Hover:** Primary darkens/dims via a translucent overlay of the same ink at ~86% opacity; Ghost gains `background: var(--fill-hover)`. `cursor: pointer` on all interactive states. * **Focus:** Distinct `:focus-visible` ring — `outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px;` — never remove it. * **Active/Pressed:** `background: var(--fill-pressed)` on ghost; primary keeps its fill with `transform: scale(0.97)`. * **Loading (`.btn--loading`):** `pointer-events: none`, `aria-busy="true"` set by JS, label hidden, a 16px `currentColor` CSS border spinner shown in its place; button dimensions must not change. * **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, `filter: grayscale(1)`, `cursor: not-allowed`, no hover/focus effects. * **Success/Error (`.btn--success`, `.btn--error`):** Temporary feedback classes using `--text-success` / `--text-error` for border and icon; state is always communicated with an icon or inline text in addition to color. **2.2 Card Component (`.card`, `.card--featured`, `.card--skeleton`, `.card--empty`)** * **Default:** Flexbox column, `align-items: flex-start`, `background: var(--bg-primary)`, `1px solid var(--border-default)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-lg)`, padding in the 8px rhythm.
